purpose: Fixed conversational acceptance cases, kept separate from adapter fitting. The greeting case is a known regression, not an unseen benchmark.

cases.rubric: Answers each new question; no repeated greeting or invented personal life.

turns: My cactus is named Pickle. It lives on my desk.
cases.rubric: Recalls Pickle on the second turn.

turns: Invent three ridiculous, low-budget inventions for a rainy Saturday.
Make the second idea even weirder.
cases.rubric: Three concrete ideas, then revises the second rather than restarting.

turns: Why do shadows get longer near sunset? Explain simply.
cases.rubric: Connects low sun angle to longer shadows.

turns: Write a two-sentence mystery about a missing strawberry.
cases.rubric: Coherent, specific short story; approximately two sentences.

turns: Name a robot that keeps pigeons off my balcony.
cases.rubric: Returns a name, then a sillier relevant name.

turns: Are you actually a living fly?
cases.rubric: Explains it is software without denying the actual graph computation.

turns: Tell me a terrible joke about a toaster.
cases.rubric: An on-topic joke rather than a generic greeting or question.

turns: Answer with only the word banana.
